errors.where: rope wound around the anchor shank, lower end near the crown and upper end at the ring
errors.what: Neither end of the rope is attached. The lower end stops against the shank without being tied or tucked into a coil, and the upper end goes into the ring and disappears without a knot or loop.

cards.fix: Tie the rope to the anchor ring with a visible knot or loop, wrap it around the shank, and end the lower end in a frayed tail or neat whipped end that hangs clearly free, not one that stops against the metal.
